the lake inside Hesperia (4 Oct 2026): a red polygon in the middle of Hesperia, with no name and no card, turned out to be the second ring of Hesperia and of the Imperial Commonwealth umbrella — the outline of an unnamed lake that the land mask left as a hole. A polygon is a nominal jurisdiction and is not cut by water (the other lakes inside polygons are covered), so a ring that lies wholly inside another ring of the same territory is no longer drawn (`C.drawRings`, used by the flat map, the globe and the working map). Display only: no canon parameter, no data and no geometry changed; the lake itself stays unnamed (a Worldbuilding question) and its readout still says shallow sea (physical layer, next physical version); see [`POLITICS_V3_NOTES.md`](https://github.com/rizkidwisulistianto-web/rhykaris-map/blob/main/docs/POLITICS_V3_NOTES.md) §11
